purpose: Teach: コレクター/木工/かなえ/ロマンス

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、コレクター、絶対、なんだろ?本気で
lines.en: Riku — are you seriously a collector or something?
lines.style: Playful accusation with a knowing smile. Light, quick rhythm. Leans in just slightly, as if sharing a joke only he'd understand. Eyebrow up, searching his face.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、木工、絶対、部、絶対、入ったって?桜
lines.en: You're seriously telling me you joined the woodwork club, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuinely surprised but trying to play it cool. Slight uptick at the end — almost a laugh caught mid-sentence. Eyes widening just a fraction before he catches himself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のクラスの、本気で、絶対、かなえ、絶対、ちゃん、絶対、お元気?本気で
lines.en: Riku — is Kanae from your class doing okay?
lines.style: Casual on the surface, but there's a careful listening underneath. Softer rhythm. Testing to see if he'll take the bait. Eyes down for a moment, then back up to watch him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ロマンス、絶対、映画、絶対、好きじゃんかよ、桜
lines.en: You're totally into romance movies, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Got-you tone. Warm teasing with affection underneath. Slight smirk in the voice. Confident, leaning back. The rhythm of someone who's caught a friend in something honest.
